milestones.goal: Delete default cube and create 'objets' collection
milestones.done_when: Default cube is deleted and 'objets' collection is created in the Outliner.
milestones.teach: Organizing objects into collections keeps your scene tidy.

milestones.done_when: Cylinder is created and 'chaise 1' and 'chaise 2' sub-collections are visible in the Outliner.
milestones.teach: Sub-collections help manage complex models with multiple parts.

milestones.done_when: Subdivision Surface modifier is added to the cylinder and appears in the modifier list.
hints: Modifier Properties > Add Modifier > Subdivision Surface
milestones.teach: Subdivision Surface smooths the mesh by adding more geometry.

milestones.goal: Adjust vertices to shape the stool
milestones.done_when: Vertices are selected and shaped to form the stool's basic structure.
hints: G to grab and move vertices
milestones.teach: Vertex manipulation is fundamental to 3D modeling.

milestones.done_when: Mirror modifier is added with Y-axis mirroring enabled.
milestones.teach: Mirror modifier creates symmetrical geometry efficiently.

milestones.goal: Add Bevel modifier to round edges
milestones.done_when: Bevel modifier is applied and edges of the stool are rounded.
milestones.teach: Bevel modifier softens hard edges for a more realistic look.
